levels.name: Level 1: Living on the Outpost
levels.blurb: Survival challenges test your decisions. Laika guides you.
briefing: No open liquids: in microgravity, a spilled drink floats and can reach the panels, vents, and the outpost's most sensitive circuits. Choose sealed drinks you can drink through a straw or valve.
No crumbly food: crumbs float into the ventilation grilles and circuit boards. Choose food that is sealed, moist, and eaten in one bite -- like irradiated chicken in a pouch.
levels.objective: Complete the three survival challenges: food, exercise, and rest.

levels.name: Level 2: Preparing for the Mission
levels.blurb: Select essential landing equipment and test the delayed communication with Laika.
briefing: The signal between Mars and Earth has a delay of several minutes. Every message you send takes time to arrive.
Choose only the equipment Laika needs for a safe landing. Distracting items have no purpose for the mission.
levels.objective: Select landing equipment and test communications with Laika.

levels.name: Level 3: Martian Surface
levels.blurb: Take photographs and collect samples while surviving sandstorms and extreme cold.
briefing: When a sandstorm begins, find shelter behind rocks, stop all scientific activities, and activate Low Power Mode. The dust is so dense that sunlight cannot reach the solar panels.
After the storm, the temperature will drop to -125°C. Activate Hibernation Mode to protect the rover's batteries. If the rover is not close enough to a lava tunnel, it will be destroyed.
levels.objective: Take photographs, survive the storm, and activate hibernation before the cold kills the rover.

levels.name: Level 4: Lava Tunnel Exploration
levels.blurb: Navigate the lava tunnel, find the rock sample and camera, and escape before time runs out.
briefing: Not all lava tunnels are safe. Turn on Laika's flashlight to navigate dark areas and identify a safe path.
Inside the tunnel, find the rock sample button and the camera button. If Laika falls, restart from the cave entrance checkpoint.
The final two minutes are a short victory sequence showing Laika returning to Earth inside the spacecraft.
levels.objective: Explore the lava tunnel, collect the rock sample and take a photo, and escape.
